meta.title: JTDA · Website build tracker
meta.headline: Designing a more distinctive JTDA experience
meta.subline: The published demo is being refined with a stronger visual identity, a Connected Jamaica hero and purposeful motion. Existing content, the information guide and all 43 videos are being preserved.
meta.currentWork: Refine the identity, Connected Jamaica hero and scroll stories
meta.currentWorkNote: Typography, composition and shared navigation are being refined alongside a lightweight Three.js Jamaica visual and scoped GSAP sequences. Reduced-motion and WebGL fallbacks, keyboard access and responsive layouts will be checked before publication. Live backend services remain unconnected.
meta.nextUpdate: Next milestone: review the rendered redesign, check mobile/tablet/desktop and motion fallbacks, then publish and verify the updated GitHub Pages demo.
meta.estimateNote: Estimates are rough active working-time ranges, not delivery promises. Provider setup and JTDA decisions can change the remaining time.
meta.scope: One responsive website: public pages, a member portal and the staff / Super Admin console. Phone layouts are mobile web views.

phases.title: Finish Figma
phases.summary: Repair the original layouts, add the admin console and complete the final responsive references.

phases.title: Website foundation
phases.summary: Next.js, TypeScript, design tokens, reusable components and editable content structure.

phases.title: Public website
phases.summary: Build the public pages, membership journey, event views, articles, search and contact flow.

phases.title: Member portal
phases.summary: Account access, dashboard, digital card, tickets, benefits, learning, directory and billing views.

phases.title: Staff & Super Admin
phases.summary: Member, event, programme, finance and content management with clear role permissions.

phases.title: Integrations & release review
phases.summary: Connect agreed services, check critical journeys, review mobile layouts and prepare the release.

phases.title: Demo updates & sharing
phases.summary: Add a basic information chatbot and all 43 verified YouTube videos, confirm password-free access, and publish the selected GitHub Pages demo.
phases.estimate: Chatbot and videos: 30–60 min each; hosting: 20–40 min after sign-in

phases.title: Visual identity & motion redesign
phases.summary: A more distinctive identity, Connected Jamaica hero, varied scroll stories and polished interactions, with responsive and accessible fallbacks.

tasks.title: Verify the existing 40 screens
tasks.note: The original Figma screens across six pages have been checked against the handoff.

tasks.title: Apply the card and spacer fixes
tasks.note: The layout and invisible-spacer corrections are applied across the six original pages.

tasks.title: Complete the Super Admin console
tasks.note: Ten desktop admin screens and two mobile web views are complete, with editable components, roles/settings and prototype navigation.

tasks.title: Fill the two desktop design gaps
tasks.note: Desktop Join step 2 and My Card are complete and passed visual and font checks.

tasks.title: Review the complete Figma file
tasks.note: Final inventory verified: 54 screen references, seven pages. New views passed visual checks; mobile references use browser-only scope.

tasks.title: Set up the website and content structure
tasks.note: Next.js App Router, TypeScript and editable MDX / JSON content.

tasks.title: Build the shared design components
tasks.note: Navigation, footer, typography, buttons, cards, form fields and portal shell.

tasks.title: Check Home at desktop and phone widths
tasks.note: Home verified at 1440, 390 and 320px; no overflow, loaded images, mobile menu, Control-K search and truthful newsletter notice checked.

tasks.title: Build the core public pages
tasks.note: Home, About, Membership, Partners, Contact and Policy & governance.

tasks.title: Build membership and event journeys
tasks.note: Four-step Join, Events, event detail and checkout views; unconfirmed prices remain clearly marked.

tasks.title: Build programmes, news and search
tasks.note: BizTech, JCSI, Programs, News, Article and keyboard-accessible search.

tasks.title: Review public mobile web layouts
tasks.note: Fourteen representative public routes passed desktop 1440px and mobile 390px checks; no horizontal overflow. Home also passed at 320px.

tasks.title: Build sign-in and account access
tasks.note: Sign-in views are complete and tested. Real magic-link/social accounts await the authentication service.

tasks.title: Build dashboard, digital card and tickets
tasks.note: Member dashboard, QR card and event / ticket views.

tasks.title: Build benefits and member resources
tasks.note: Perks, Learning & CPD, Jobs and Directory.

tasks.title: Build billing and member mobile views
tasks.note: All fourteen Join/sign-in/member routes passed at 1440px and 390px. Nine member journey checks passed; billing remains sample data.

tasks.title: Build admin access, overview and members
tasks.note: Overview, members and organisations review are complete and tested. Live access and server-enforced roles await authentication and database services.

tasks.title: Build event and programme management
tasks.note: Review event CRUD, waitlists, check-in validation and duplicate protection passed; mobile check-in fits 390px. Production QR credentials remain pending.

tasks.title: Build finance, partners and perks management
tasks.note: Payments, invoice and reconciliation views, partner records and member offers.

tasks.title: Build content, moderation and settings
tasks.note: News and pages, jobs moderation, plans, email templates, admin users and audit log.

tasks.title: Connect the agreed production services
tasks.note: No live backend services connected. Durable data, real accounts, email delivery, payment webhooks and signed credentials are the next implementation dependency.

tasks.title: Check the critical journeys and accessibility
tasks.note: Review checks passed: 56 public/member layout checks, 9 member journeys, 8 admin UI checks, 7 public interactions, 5 cross-page checks and zero axe violations on five representative pages. Connected live journeys still require testing.

tasks.title: Prepare the website for release review
tasks.note: The password-free website review and Next.js source package are ready. Final launch needs approved content/policies, confirmed prices/dates, live services and production deployment settings.

tasks.title: Add the basic information chatbot
tasks.note: 30 prepared topics, typed questions and clickable options. 44 matcher scenarios, responsive layouts and keyboard/accessibility checks passed. No AI or message transmission.

tasks.title: Add all 43 verified YouTube videos
tasks.note: 43 verified uploads, searchable filters, video selection and click-to-load YouTube playback. Desktop and mobile layouts checked; historical content is labelled.

tasks.title: Confirm password-free public access
tasks.note: GitHub Pages and both original Sites open publicly. Unauthenticated HTTP checks returned the pages directly, with no sign-in redirect.

tasks.title: Publish the demo on GitHub Pages
tasks.note: Published at tillmate.github.io/jtda-website-demo with the tracker at /build-progress/. GitHub deployment succeeded and unauthenticated website, videos, admin review and tracker requests returned HTTP 200.

tasks.title: Strengthen identity, typography and page composition
tasks.note: Refine graphite and warm-white surfaces, restrained cyan/gold accents, larger typography, authentic photography and shared navigation/footer states. Preserve the existing content and destinations.

tasks.title: Build the Connected Jamaica hero
tasks.note: Create an accurate Jamaica outline with conceptual connections, lightweight Three.js depth and a static SVG fallback. Keep both primary actions available and respect reduced motion.

tasks.title: Add purposeful GSAP stories and small interactions
tasks.note: Coordinate the four pillars, BizTech photography and history timeline; keep events and membership easy to scan. Use native scrolling and clean up animation resources on route changes.

tasks.title: Check responsive layouts, accessibility and motion fallbacks
tasks.note: Inspect desktop, tablet and mobile screenshots; test keyboard navigation, reduced motion, unavailable WebGL, route changes, overflow, broken resources and retained video/guide interactions.

tasks.title: Build, publish and verify the redesigned demo
tasks.note: Run the production export with the GitHub Pages base path, publish the reviewed files and verify the live address. Existing public links continue to show the last published version until then.

dependencies.title: Figma completion
dependencies.detail: Figma is complete and verified. Website development started on 13 October 2026.

dependencies.title: Database, sign-in and email
dependencies.detail: The providers and account setup still need to be defined. Page and component work can proceed before services are connected.

dependencies.title: Payments and staff permissions
dependencies.detail: Confirm the payment methods, operational settings and the exact permissions for each staff role.

dependencies.title: GitHub Pages connection
dependencies.detail: GitHub Pages deployment succeeded. The clean public address and progress page were checked without authentication.

dependencies.title: Optional AI learning roadmap
dependencies.detail: A personalised roadmap grounded in verified JTDA programmes is a proposed future enhancement. It is not implemented and is outside this demo checklist. The basic information chatbot remains non-AI.

confirmations.title: Membership fees
confirmations.detail: Keep unpublished fees labelled Pricing TBC. Confirm fees and plan details before enabling real checkout.

confirmations.title: Programme and event details
confirmations.detail: Confirm JCSI cost and duration, BizTech 2027 dates and venue, and the sample event dates.

confirmations.title: JTDA contact and brand assets
confirmations.detail: Confirm the press email and real LinkedIn company page, and supply higher-resolution headshots when available.

confirmations.title: Tillmate member offer
confirmations.detail: Retain Proposed partner · Offer TBC until the offer is confirmed. Keep the agreed in-kind website credit.

updates.text: Website build started. Figma complete; final copy corrections remove unconfirmed exchange estimates and identify sample event details.
Figma completed: 54 screen references across seven pages. Super Admin, responsive web layouts and both missing desktop views verified.
Original Figma screen inventory verified and layout fixes applied. Remaining admin and desktop references are in progress. Website development has not started.
Website foundation checked. Home passes 1440, 390 and 320px browser checks. Public, member and admin views are implemented and undergoing review; live services remain pending.

Private website review published. Production build passed; public/member layouts, admin operations, review forms, cross-page navigation and representative accessibility checks passed. Live backend integrations and JTDA launch confirmations remain.

Demo-sharing updates started: the non-AI information chatbot and all 43 verified JTDA YouTube videos are in progress. Password-free public access is confirmed on both existing Sites. GitHub Pages was selected; device sign-in is pending before publication. Live backend services remain unconnected.
Chatbot and video library completed and checked. GitHub connection is ready; the compiled website and tracker are being published on GitHub Pages.

GitHub Pages publication succeeded. Website, video library, sample admin and tracker returned HTTP 200 without authentication. All four demo-sharing tasks are complete; live backend integrations and JTDA confirmations remain.

Visual redesign started from the new brief. Identity/layout, the Connected Jamaica hero and purposeful scroll stories are in progress; responsive/accessibility checks and publication follow. Rough estimate: 1–2 hours of active work across parallel tasks. Existing content, the non-AI guide and all 43 videos remain in scope.
